notes.title: Minilog #66 is here! Meet the second mini-boss from Meawja
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30739165/a0c1c79ddcfca7c97dc60293384ae05d2c25bb40.jpg

Greetings, ninjas!

As promised, we will post announcements here on Steam when there are updates on Meawja's development progress. All our logs are posted on Patreon, however, we keep those posts open for everyone to read!

Minilog #66 shows a bit about In-Gon! The second miniboss you'll find in the game!

SPOILER ALERT! 
We post the logs to let everyone knows that we keep working on Meawja, but read the articles at your own risk! For fresh gameplay, we suggest you wait for the game's release ❤

Click here to read Minilog #66!


Latest logs:
 Minilog #65 - Nuru, the first boss, is finished!
 Minilog #64 - The first miniboss is finished! + sneak peek on Nuru, the first Master
 Minilog #63 - Bosses redesign
 Minilog #62 - The Hidden Swamp Enemies
 Minilog #61 - Moving to develop the last stage: The Hidden Swamp!
Onward, ninjas! ◣◢

notes.title: Steam Page and Official Website updated
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30739165/57797a909aa87ac83f519fbf6d7de9511bcebfa0.png

Greetings, ninjas!

It's been a while since our latest post, but don't worry, Meawja's development is doing awesome! We have already finished all the stages and are currently working on the boss fights. They are super fun and we hope you all like them as well.

All the screenshots on the Steam Page have been updated! We would like to apologize for not updating the Steam page often, but be sure that we keep working hard! Oh, and our official website has been updated as well, check it out:

https://galopeteam.com/

The best way to follow our development progress is through our pages that we update constantly:


 Twitter
 Patreon (all dev logs are open for everyone)
 Discord Server

The game is probably around 85% development competition, which is a great milestone! There is still much to do, but we hope to finish them all asap. Here is a simplified list of what's left to be finished:

 3 Boss Fights
 6 Songs
 Cutscenes
 Dialogues
 Menus


Below is a small collection of gameplay videos we have posted. There are no more videos because we want most of the game's content to be a surprise, so the next videos will probably be short trailers. Check it out:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WmZ-PAoHTPQ
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BCtQj6H4Aq8
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RmcFwirsWGY

Hope you like it! Can't wait to release the full game!

Would you like us to update the Steam page more often? Or just create news for bigger updates? Leave your thoughts below!

Onward, ninjas! ◣◢

notes.title: First Gameplay video is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WmZ-PAoHTPQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings, ninjas!

We are super excited to post this video! As promised, Meawja has a new, fresh look after the rework, like a totally new game! The video shows the first two stages: the Bamboo Forest and the Crystal Caves.

The project lives! We are working hard to make a fun, challenging and charming ninja experience. This rework added some interesting new mechanics, the visuals are updated and of course, the game flows way better.

Development logs
We're posting constantly our development progress through our Patreon page. You can follow us by clicking the link below:

https://www.patreon.com/galopeteam

All logs posted there are open to everyone! We like to show our progress and having support from our fans is like a super motivation fuel. You can also follow or Twitter and receive those updates easily as well:

https://twitter.com/galope_team

What do you think about the gameplay, ninjas? Let us know your thoughts in the comments! Every feedback is welcome!

Oh, and you can also join our Discord Server! Everyone is welcome! Updates, news and maybe some wild memes might show up from the grass. Just click the link below for the auto-invite:

https://discord.gg/Qac8t8E

Just remember to respect all the other ninjas!

Onward!! ◣◢

notes.title: We now have a Patreon page!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30739165/0a728f1db9c416daec76c5e0b1098035c4da243d.jpg

Greetings, ninjas!

We are happy to announce that Galope now has a Patreon page! If you wish to support us a little further, your help will greatly be appreciated! You can know a little bit more about on the link as well:

https://www.patreon.com/galopeteam

Meawja is being developed at full steam! You can know more about the hero Rework, the new features and many more on our first post on Patreon:

https://www.patreon.com/posts/our-work-so-far-26512668



>>> What is Patreon?

It is a way to support creators with a monthly income. You can help with just a little tip, only 1$ or any sum you wish, and with the help of many other supporters, the creators may have a nice financial help to keep working and improving their projects! For Galope, this will help us to keep producing the games and also with the development costs. In return, there are regular updates and specific rewards like your name in the games credits, access to BETA testing and keys! Click on the link to know more =3

Thanks everyone for every kind of support! You are the best!!

Onward! ◣◢
